This scaffold cannot include the binary gradle-wrapper.jar.

Before the first build, generate the wrapper jar + scripts so the pinned
Gradle 8.10.2 (see gradle-wrapper.properties) is used:

    cd android
    gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.10.2

If you do not have a system `gradle`, copy the wrapper jar from any
RN 0.74+ template:

    cp node_modules/react-native/template/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar \
       android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar

Then `./gradlew assembleDebug` will work.
